主要内容: Equifax Workforce Solutions, a business unit of Equifax, hosted FORUM 2015 in New Orleans, an annual client event themed "Lead the Parade." The event attracted over 10 million employees and industry analysts, focusing on compliance expertise, data analytics, and human capital insights. Sessions covered ACA reporting requirements, immigration reform, and compliance mistakes. Debra Parent, senior manager at Pacific Sunwear, highlighted the event's value in providing workforce trend insights. Networking sessions allowed clients to engage with peers and experience Equifax Workforce Solutions technologies through product demos. The company emphasized its transformation from a data and analytics provider to an insights-driven business, aiming to meet evolving HR process demands. Rick Smith, chairman and CEO of Equifax, noted the importance of Workforce Solutions as a key differentiator for the company, offering clients access to workforce trends and innovative solutions. Equifax is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) under the symbol EFX. In 2014, Equifax was recognized as a Bloomberg BusinessWeek Top 50 company and named to the Fintech 100 list. The company's focus on innovation and data-driven solutions positions it as a significant player in the information services industry.
